summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and private helper _resolve_path (standard library only). Added explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py. Added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with an autofunction entry after the Utilities automodule in docs/source/data.rst. Added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist and four tests. Line lengths were verified by measurement (none over 120). Tests were not run, black/flake8 were not run, and nothing was committed.
